text:
Hannah Park: Hi all, first day! Quick onboarding security question: my laptop shipped but MDM enrollment shows 'pending attestation' and my training portal says I'm already in a phishing cohort. Can I still join meetings if the device is noncompliant? Also, I'd prefer not to register my personal phone for Duo. What's the exemption flow?

Priya Kapoor: Welcome Hannah! :wave: You can attend most meetings but access to sensitive repos and customer data may be blocked until compliance is fixed. For Duo opt-out, manager approval + security review is required; we usually issue a hardware key (YubiKey) or a short-lived OTP as an interim. Fill the personal-device exception form in the KB and cc your manager.

Hannah Park: Got it. The attestation status says: "failed (client_cert not trusted)". IT pushed a CA earlier today, but status didn't change.

IT Ops: Hi Hannah  sorry about that. Can you run `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste the output? If attestation still fails we'll try re-provisioning the device or push the intermediate cert again. Also let us know if you can join a 10-min remote session.

Hannah Park: Paste: "Enrolled
Compliance: noncompliant
Attestation: failed (400)
Error: client_cert_not_trusted". I can do remote at 3:15pm PT.

Liam Chen: @Hannah I had a similar error last month. IT pushed the CA and then forced a re-check from Jamf (Device > Actions > Update Inventory) and that fixed it. If IT can't push, ask them to re-run attestation from the console.

Priya Kapoor: Phishing note: if you get a simulated phish and click, you'll receive immediate feedback and a 5-10min micro-training. No punitive action for a single fail. We only follow up for repeated failures after coaching.

security-bot: Security training queued: "New Hire Security Basics" -> Hannah Park. Due date: 2026-02-12. Link: https://training.redwood-internal/learn/nh-security-basics

IT Ops: We'll take the remote session at 3:15pm PT. If attestation still fails we'll escalate and either push the cert chain or re-image the device. For the Duo exemption: attach manager approval to the exception form and security will review within 2 business days.

Hannah Park: Thanks everyone  joining the remote now. Also @Priya I'll submit the exception form but prefer YubiKey if approved.

Priya Kapoor: Sounds good Hannah  cc your manager on the form and security will handle the review. See you at 3:15.
